description.en-US: Show the Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, or National Geographic title you're watching.
description.fr-FR: Affichez le titre Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars ou National Geographic que vous regardez.
description.es-ES: Muestra el título de Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars o National Geographic que estás viendo.
description.de-DE: Zeige den Titel von Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars oder National Geographic, den du ansiehst.
description.el-GR: Εμφάνιση του τίτλου Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars ή National Geographic που παρακολουθείτε.
description.ja-JP: 視聴中のDisney、Pixar、Marvel、Star Wars、National Geographicの作品を表示します。
description.ko-KR: 시청 중인 Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars 또는 National Geographic 콘텐츠를 표시합니다.
description.ms-MY: Tunjukkan judul Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars atau National Geographic yang anda tonton.
description.pl-PL: Pokazuj oglądany tytuł Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars lub National Geographic.
description.pt-BR: Mostrar o título da Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars ou National Geographic que você está assistindo.
description.tr-TR: İzlediğin Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars veya National Geographic içeriğini göster.

longDescription.en-US: Disney+ brings together movies, series, and franchises from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, and National Geographic. This presence shows the title you're watching, including season and episode when it applies.
longDescription.fr-FR: Disney+ réunit films, séries et franchises de Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars et National Geographic. Cette présence affiche le titre que vous regardez, avec la saison et l'épisode le cas échéant.
longDescription.es-ES: Disney+ reúne películas, series y franquicias de Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars y National Geographic. Esta presencia muestra el título que estás viendo, con temporada y episodio cuando corresponde.
longDescription.de-DE: Disney+ vereint Filme, Serien und Franchises von Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars und National Geographic. Diese Präsenz zeigt den Titel, den du gerade ansiehst, gegebenenfalls einschließlich Staffel und Folge.
longDescription.el-GR: Το Disney+ συγκεντρώνει ταινίες, σειρές και franchise από τα Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars και National Geographic. Αυτή η παρουσία εμφανίζει τον τίτλο που παρακολουθείτε, μαζί με τη σεζόν και το επεισόδιο, όπου ισχύει.
longDescription.ja-JP: Disney+では、Disney、Pixar、Marvel、Star Wars、National Geographicの映画、シリーズ、人気作品をまとめて楽しめます。このプレゼンスには視聴中のタイトルが表示され、該当する場合はシーズンとエピソードも表示されます。
longDescription.ko-KR: Disney+에서는 Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars 및 National Geographic의 영화, 시리즈와 프랜차이즈 콘텐츠를 한곳에서 만나볼 수 있습니다. 이 활동 상태에는 시청 중인 콘텐츠의 제목이 표시되며, 해당하는 경우 시즌과 에피소드도 표시됩니다.
longDescription.ms-MY: Disney+ menghimpunkan filem, siri dan francais daripada Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars dan National Geographic. Kehadiran ini menunjukkan tajuk yang sedang anda tonton, termasuk musim dan episod jika berkenaan.
longDescription.pl-PL: Disney+ łączy filmy, seriale i franczyzy Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars oraz National Geographic. Ta aktywność pokazuje tytuł oglądanej treści, w tym sezon i odcinek, jeśli ma to zastosowanie.
longDescription.pt-BR: O Disney+ reúne filmes, séries e franquias da Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars e National Geographic. Esta presença mostra o título que você está assistindo, incluindo temporada e episódio quando aplicável.
longDescription.tr-TR: Disney+, Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars ve National Geographic'in film, dizi ve serilerini bir araya getirir. Bu durum, izlediğin içeriğin adını ve uygun olduğunda sezon ile bölüm bilgilerini gösterir.
